entries.title: Psalms 134:1
segments:
PSALM CXXXIV. 
 
  In this psalm the priests or Levites who watched all night in the   temple, exhort one another, and pray for one another, ver. 1-3.   A song of degrees. 
 
  V. 1. Servant-Peculiarly so called, priests and Levites. Night-Not only by day, but also by night, when their watch was more necessary.  Stand-Serve or minister.

entries.title: Psalms 134:3
segments: V. 3. Thee-Thee whosoever thou art who dost faithfully perform the duty here commanded.
